title: mobile record page: a disabled Edit (edit.disabledWhen or editLockedByState) still takes the bottom bar's first slot — move it into the overflow like the approval-lock case (#35016)
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filed by triage at the request of repo:objectstack#3 (area o3-D, mailbox #32588, 6967787528), from #35016 / PR #35073.

## What happens
On a phone, the record page's bottom bar gives its first (primary) slot to **Edit even when Edit is disabled**, whether by an `edit.disabledWhen` predicate or by `editLockedByState`. PR #35073 moves Edit into the bar's ⋯ only when the **approval lock** is on, as #35016 scoped it. The other disable reasons were left as they are.

## Done when
A disabled Edit, for any reason, yields the primary slot: it moves to ⋯ and the next available action is promoted, with the disabled reason still readable. Pins cover `disabledWhen` and `editLockedByState`.

Grade: **p2 · domain:ui**. Theme: epic #34571's mobile scope (手机端). The same behaviour for the approval case was graded p1 by the coordinator. These are the rarer disable reasons, and nothing is blocked (the user can still reach every action), so p2 rather than p1. The seat suggested p3, but a wasted primary slot is user-facing in an in-focus theme. Not linked under #34571, and routed to seat 4.
